column3: Sat close up early - second at halfway - moved through to hit the front approaching the straight - kicked clear inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to win comfortably
Settled handy early - 4th at halfway - 5th with 4f left - moved up into 3rd turning for home - could not close on the winner in 2nd - held there without gaining ground late to finish second
Settled with the pack early - 5th six furlongs out then 6th with four to go - improved into 4th turning for home - pushed into 3rd a furlong out - stayed on at an even tack to finish third
Held up towards the back of the field - improved into 5th turning for home - unable to close in modest 4th final furlong and stayed one-dimensional to the line
Held up towards back - improved into 6th with 6f left but couldn't threaten leaders in 5th with a furlong to go - stayed on late to finish 5th
Held up towards the back - began finding room approaching the straight - close to mid-division with 1 1/2f left - stayed on late but held to sixth
Handy early - 4th at halfway then 3rd 4f out - dropped back entering straight - chased home in 7th with 1 1/2f left - unable to find more late
Went straight to front early - overtaken entering the straight - dropped away inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 8th
Tracked leaders early - third at halfway before being ridden along in fourth 4f out - dropped away over 2f out to finish well held
Settled at the back and drifted a touch adrift early - regained touch with the pack after 2f - improved into 7th with 6f left - lost ground from 2 1/2f out and finished well held
Held up at back - lost touch from 6f out - dropped away late to finish well beaten
Settled in the pack early - lost touch and slipped to the back by halfway - fell right away and finished a distant last
Held up towards the back of the pack - lost touch and needed encouragement after 6f - faded from halfway and finished a long way behind
Fought for control early - set the pace throughout - pushed along with 2f remaining and edged away - stayed on strongly to the line

Settled with a strong grip early - close to the front group - dropped away and pressed for effort with 3f left - rallied into the last furlong - grabbed second near the finish but couldn't get to the winner
Fought for control early - travelled close to the pace - pressed for effort and dropped back 3f out - responded late to grab third close home
Fought for control early - settled in the pack - pressed for the lead over 2f out but soon left behind - lost ground final furlong to finish fourth
Settled at back early - made steady progress 3f out and pressed for the lead entering final furlong - lost place inside final 110 yards - finished 5th
Pulling hard early - settled mid-pack before dropping away under pressure with over 5f left - well beaten from 2f out
Held up at the back - pushed along with 2f left - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - fended off a strong rival close home to score
Settled at the rear - pressed for effort with 2f left - closed strongly through the finish - narrowly beaten into 2nd
Sent to the front early - pressed for effort inside the final two furlongs - lost the advantage close home - stayed on to finish third
Fresh early - up with leading group - pushed along over 2f out and stayed on at one gauge to finish 4th beaten 3 lengths
Held up towards the back - pushed along with hopes alive over 2f out - lost momentum inside final furlong - finished 5th
Settled close to the front - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away inside final 2f - eventually well held
Handy early behind pace - hit front 2nd - opened clear gap by 7th - margin narrowed after 4 out - moving smoothly approaching 2 out - shot clear at the last - kept finding more - won comfortably

Settled early with the pack - moved into 3rd after the 7th - advanced into contention approaching 4 out - up to 2nd 3 out - unable to reel in the winner and hit the last - stayed on at one gait to finish 2nd
Settled with the pack early - moved up to 2nd after the 6th - pressed forward into 3rd by 3 out - unable to land a blow on the pair in front - stayed on late but never really challenging
Settled midfield early - improved into 5th approaching 4 out - unable to close on the leading group after 3 out - stayed on at one gait to finish 4th

Settled in the pack early - improved into 6th then 4th with four out - unable to threaten the leading pair from 3 out - held a steady 4th over 2 out - lost momentum late and slipped to 5th at the finish
Held up in the pack early - up to 8th after the 6th and 7th after 4 out - couldn't quicken from 2 out - well held at the finish

Settled just behind the pace early - hit the front briefly before yielding it again - scratchy over the 3rd - slipped back to 5th after the 6th fence - unable to make headway in 6th after four out - held that position with nothing more to offer before two out
Held up at back - hampered after 1st and lost a little touch with the field - awkward next - improved into 9th after 6th - couldn't quicken from 2 out and well held at the finish
Held up near the back - slipped further down the field after the 6th before losing touch approaching 4 out - eased and pulled up before 3 out
Went straight to front - overtaken soon after - settled just behind rivals then 3rd after 6th and 4th after 7th - dropped back and pushed along before 4 out - faded and eased before 3 out - pulled up
Held up towards the back - blundered and unseated at the first
Held up towards back - stopped before 4th
Asked for effort early - went straight to front - scratchy jump at the 8th - shaken up to open daylight advantage 2 out - stayed on to the last then eased in front but held on to score
Went straight to front - handed up spot near pace after being overtaken - dropped away 3 out - pressed for effort 2 out and stayed on but couldn't reel in winner
Fought for control early - settled at back of field - made progress from 8th - still handy 3 out - pushed along before 2 out - moved into third by last and stayed on to finish third
Fighting for control early - settled in the pack - moved up to second three out - pressed for effort but slipped back two out and faded
Held up in the pack - squeezed for space and slipped to the back after the 8th - still within range 3 out before fading to finish fifth
Held up rear early - never a factor - well held at finish
Settled at the back - pushed along 3f out - angled left for room and rallied strongly inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line - got up in a photo
Held handy in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - moved through to the front inside the final furlong - stayed on but caught right at the line
Sent to the front early - pressed for effort with 2f left before giving way approaching the last furlong - unable to hold on and dropped a place near the line
Held mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - stayed on gamely inside the closing furlong - finished 4th
Sat close to the front - pushed into contention 3f out - kept on at one gear finishing fifth
Held up towards the back from the off - unable to challenge the front group - finished sixth well beaten
Held up at the back - never a threat - well beaten in 7th
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort 3f out and lost touch soon after - well beaten by the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left but couldn't respond - dropped right away before the finish and well held

Sent to front early - lost advantage before 3rd - back in command after 6th - challenged 3 out then edged ahead before 2 out - overtaken approaching last - regained control on run-in and stayed on strongly to prevail
Settled with the pack early - third from the sixth - pushed to keep pace turning for home - responded past two out - improved into second by the last - stuck on to finish second

Sat behind pacesetter early - went in front before 3rd then lost that spot after 6th - level with rival 3 out - pushed back into 2nd before 2 out - edged back in front near the last - overtaken on the run to the line - eased into 3rd close home - stayed on at one gear finishing third
Held up early - progress into mid-division then fourth with 4 to jump - unable to close and lost touch after 3 out - one-paced to the last finishing fourth
Held up towards the back - slipped further back after the 4th - improved into 4th by the 6th - hit the 8th before being pulled up four out
Settled in the pack early - still close to the front travelling well 3 out - pushed to the front 2 out and clear approaching last - stayed on to score

Sent off eagerly early - hit the front before losing it approaching 2nd - close up with pace-setter through 6th - driven along and well placed when stumbling 2 out - pressed the pace afterwards - stayed on to move up into runner-up spot inside final furlong - unable to get past winner
Settled towards back early - still close enough 3f out - pressed for effort 2f out - responded well nearing final furlong - moved into third close home to finish 3rd

Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - hit the first and second obstacles untidily before going to the front - opened up a big advantage - scrambled over the fourth - margin narrowed by the fifth - another mistake three out - overtaken two out - driven along and close enough to the leader nearing the last - gave way in the final furlong to finish fourth
Held up early - never a factor - finished well held

Set the pace early - dropped back but stayed in touch after a furlong - pushed back into the front spot approaching the final furlong - fought hard side by side inside the last - lost the advantage for a moment near the line - dug in to get up and win
Held up at the back - angled right for space and pushed along 2f out - progress through rivals then stayed on inside the last - hit the front close home but overtaken again - beaten by a whisker
Held up towards back - pushed along 2f out - responded to close late - closed strongly to grab third near line - just failed to catch front pair
Up with the front group early - pushed along past the 2f marker and made ground under pressure into the last furlong - edged back to fourth late
Handy early - pushed to front after a furlong - under pressure 2f out - overtaken soon after - stayed on inside final furlong but slipped back late to finish fifth
Held up mid-pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - kept on without gaining over 1f out - finished sixth beaten 4 lengths
Held a midpack spot through the race - pressed for effort with 2f left but found little more - kept on unchanged to the line finishing 7th
Sluggish start - pushed up from the back - stayed off the pace throughout - finished eighth beaten 6 lengths
Handy in behind front group early - pushed along with 2f left - lost place inside final furlong - finished ninth
Held up in tail of the field - never went close to challenging - finished well held in 10th
Held up in the pack wide - pressed for effort with 2f left but unable to find extra pace - dropped away and allowed to coast home well held
Sat close up early - level with front-runner after 3rd - went ahead at the 4th - challenged into the straight - edged clear at the last despite a mistake there and stayed on strongly to prevail
Handy early - dropped to 2nd then 6th - scrappy jump 3 out before regaining touch - closed on pacesetter turning in - couldn't get past up the straight - stayed on to finish second

Prominent in 5th - moved to 4th by the 8th - pressing into contention after 4 out - up to 3rd approaching the straight - not clean at 2 out - plugged on down the run-in but never in a position to challenge for third

Went straight to front - shared advantage before 3rd then lost command by 4th - settled 3rd before slipping to 6th - back to 5th turning into straight - unable to threaten the front pair - held a steady 4th before the last
Held up at back of pack - improved from 8th to 6th before pushed along approaching 3 out - stayed on steadily to finish 5th
Held up handy early and pulling hard - settled 4th then 6th - back to 5th at the 8th - 4th turning into the straight - unable to threaten in front 2 out - held on for 6th without finding more

Handy early - slipped back before rallying into 6th - improved after 7th - jumped awkwardly 3 out - driven with little response - stayed one paced into 2 out and again not the best there - well held at finish
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway approaching 3 out - one paced from 2 out - eventually well beaten in 8th
Held up towards the back of the pack - briefly improved from 10th to 6th but made no dent on the leaders - faded before 2 out to finish well beaten
Held up towards the back - clumsy over the opening two flights - improved into contention entering the straight before fading two out
Settled around midfield early - crept into contention before three out but hit that obstacle awkwardly and slipped back - faded through the straight to finish well held
Settled with the pack early - up to 7th then 6th before dropping back approaching 3 out - faded from there to finish well held
Held up towards the back - clipped a fence 6th and again 4 out with little response - lost touch 3 out - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back - unable to make headway - dropped away 3 out and pulled up before 2 out
Held up towards the back - hit the 4th and made no progress - dropped away 3 out - eased and pulled up before 2 out
Held up at the back throughout - made no headway - dropped away before 3 out and pulled up approaching 2 out
Handy early despite a mistake - hit front three out - pushed along and opened up before two out - stayed on to last - margin shortened near the line but held on for the win
Settled at back early - untidy leap 10th - still within range 3 out - moved into second with easy progress 2 out - pressed for effort soon after - stayed on to close but not quite enough
Held up in the pack - moved into contention before 2 out and went after the winner - plugged on at one speed approaching the last
Fought for control early - up with the pace before easing back after 3 out - unable to close and finished well held
Settled at the back early - still handy 3 out but pressed for effort and lost ground - unable to close in from there and beaten off before the last
Jumped raggedly early - pulling hard in front - error 3 out saw rivals go by - pressed for effort soon after - lost ground before 2 out and beaten into 6th
Held up eager at the back - pushed along with 2f left - moved right and stayed on a furlong out - stormed clear inside the last to score
Settled midpack early - pushed along with two furlongs left - hit front with a furlong to run - overtaken soon after - stayed on but outpaced by winner late
Handy behind front pack early - eased right and pushed along over 2f out - stayed on to grab third
towards the back early - pushed to improve into the straight - moved right and driven with 2f left - stayed on inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Set the pace early - pushed along approaching 2f out - lost the advantage inside final furlong - dropped away quickly after - finished fifth well held
settled in the pack - pressed for effort with over 3f left - unable to close on the front group - lost place inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat just behind the pace early - pushed into command over 1f out but soon overtaken - faded fast inside the closing stages to finish 7th
Held up handy in the early stages - pushed along with 3f left - dropped away over 2f out - finished well beaten in 8th
Settled in the pack early - improved after three out to sit fifth turning for home - fought on into third by the last - rallied strongly on the run-in to snatch the win right at the finish
Settled with the pack early - moved into 6th after 4 out - made ground 2 out to be 2nd at the last - stayed on well to the line - narrowly denied in 2nd
Held up in the pack - made ground 3 out - up to 8th entering the straight - moved into contention 2 out - stayed on late to grab 3rd right at the line

Handy early - 5th after fifth - improved into contention past three out - nudged in front turning into straight - tried to go clear two out - stayed on through final furlong before losing the advantage near the line - one paced and finished fourth
Held up towards the back - improved position after 3 out - 7th turning into straight - progressed before last - finished well in 5th but held
Settled towards the back of the pack - moved into contention around 4 out - stayed on into 2nd approaching 2 out - dropped back before the last - unable to hold on and eased back to 6th at the finish
Settled midpack early - moved up into 4th turning for home before slipping back and pressed for effort by two out - unable to find more from there and finished 7th beaten 11 1/4 lengths
Held up at the back - made progress after 3 out - 9th turning into straight - lost place at the last after a blunder
Held up towards the back - crept into contention after the third-last but found little approaching two out - faded before the final fence to finish ninth
Handy early - slipped back through midfield turning in - unable to find more 2 out - well held in 10th
Held up in the pack - made headway approaching 3 out - unable to quicken after 2 out - well held at the finish

Set the pace from the off - stretched clear after the first before a heavy blunder at the 5th cut the margin - overtaken with the turn into the straight and driven along - dropped away in a hurry before two out and finished well beaten in 12th
Handy in touch early - disputing second before hitting a mistake 4 out - dropped away and pushed along - faded from 3 out to finish last of the beaten lot
Held up at back of field - never a factor - dropped away after 3 out - well beaten in 14th
Settled with leading group early - dropped away approaching 6th - faded from 3 out - well held at finish
Held up towards the back - improved into 8th by 4 out - dropped away after 3 out to finish well beaten
Settled with the pack early - moved into 3rd after the 5th before dropping back 3 out - faded late to finish well beaten
Sat close up early travelling keenly - slipped back through the pack and asked for effort after 4 out - lost more ground before 3 out - faltered and was eased before 2 out and pulled up
settled at the back - good progress from 9th - moved into second 3 out - swept to the front 2 out - nudged out approaching the last - stayed on to win comfortably
Set the pace early - pressed and lost front spot two out - stayed close approaching last before fading to finish second
Held up handy in the pack - dropped away 3 out and driven along without answer - regained third spot before 2 out - held effort to the line finishing 3rd
Settled in the pack early - jumped awkwardly 5th - still handy 3 out - pushed along and dropped away - edged closer approaching last then stayed on but couldn't get third
Sat close to the front early - dropped a place 3 out - unable to live with the pace from there - urged along before 2 out - faded turning into the final furlong
Untidy over the obstacles - held up at the rear throughout - pulled up before the second last
Held up at the back - pushed along with 2f left - responded and stayed on - moved through to hit the front inside the last 110yds and drove clear
Handy early - pushed along to hit front inside final furlong - stayed on well but caught close home
Settled at the rear early - urged into a strong move approaching the last furlong while edging off a true line to the right - stayed on nicely close home to grab third place
Held mid-pack early - angled left for room and pushed along inside final 2f then bumped - stayed on to finish fourth beaten 1¾ lengths
Held up mid-pack - pushed along and made progress a furlong out - stayed on inside the last to finish fifth
Held mid-pack towards the wide side - pushed along with 2f left - lost ground inside the last - finished 6th
Took a strong hold early - sat close to the pace - pressed for effort with a furlong to go - lost ground near the finish to end seventh
Held up eagerly early - hit front soon after start then urged along inside final furlong - lost advantage and faded finishing 8th

Settled 2nd - moved up after the 2nd - not clean at the 4th last - up with the pace 3 out - going strongly into the straight and hit the front - drew right away from 2 out where another jumping error - in command before the last - hands and heels to the line to win with plenty in hand

Sat 3rd early - clipped heels 6th - pushed along 3 out - moved into 2nd approaching straight but couldn't reel in front-runner - held together into 2nd only stayed on same pace - stumbled at last - held on for 2nd

Set the early pace with a good margin - jumped awkwardly second - gap narrowed steadily - overtaken entering the straight - slipped back to third before two out and found little more late - held that spot to finish
Settled 4th early on eager side - stumbled and lost fluency over 5th - dropped away from the pack soon after - lost touch after 3 out to finish 4th
Took a share of the front - moved into sole command 3 out - three lengths up and under pressure 2 out - pulled further ahead approaching the last - kept on strongly to win with comfort
Jumped ragged early - shared front spot before losing it 3 out - pressed for effort approaching 2 out - dropped away from there - unable to close on the run to the line
Settled at back of field - pushed along with no headway made - hit two out - finished third
Sat close to the front early - pushed to the front approaching the final furlong - fought back under pressure from a rival late - held on by a whisker at the line
Held up towards back - pushed along over 2f out - improved and drifted right inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to finish - narrowly beaten into 2nd
settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - drifted right inside the closing furlong and stayed on at one gauge to finish third
Sat close to the pace early - hit the front after 1f and stayed there - pushed along 2f out then lost the advantage inside the final furlong - faded to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside final furlong - beaten into 5th
settled in the pack - pressed for effort a furlong out - lost ground close home to finish sixth
Held up at rear from the off - never involved and finished well held in 7th

Settled with the pack early - moved up to 3rd before 3 out - went 2nd turning in - hit front before 2 out - shook off rivals at the last - opened up a big margin - kept finding more up the run-in - won unchallenged

Handy up in second early despite a mistake - held that spot before a brief move to fourth - slipped back to third turning into the straight - unable to threaten the pacesetter and awkward two out and again at the last - rallied for a clear second - always held by the runaway winner

Went straight to front early - opened up further approaching 4 out - small error 3 out cut margin - overtaken before 2 out - couldn't threaten new front-runner and stumbled at last - eased back to third and finished evenly
Sat just behind the front rank early - slipped back to 6th approaching 3 out - regained 4th by 2 out - unable to trouble the front two near the finish - stayed on late to be fourth
Settled early close up - fourth turning in - slipped to fifth two out and hit that one awkwardly - unable to threaten - held on at one speed to finish fifth
Held up towards the back - clipped the first - still down in 9th by the 4th - pushed along in 7th approaching two out - stayed on without threatening up the run-in - finished sixth

Midfield - jumping errors cost rhythm including at the 4th and again 3 out - moved up approaching the straight before falling back to 6th before 2 out - another error at the last and finished tired in 7th
Held up towards the back of the pack - still 8th after the 4th and unable to make headway - lost touch before 2 out and scratchy over that flight - well beaten in 8th
Held up towards the back - blundered at the 4th and dropped to 10th - never a threat and lost touch before 2 out
Held up at back - clipped the first and second fences awkwardly - drifted off the pack - another blunder at the fourth - lost touch before two out and beaten a long way home

Held up towards the back of the pack early - 7th after the fourth with little threat approaching three out - slipped towards the tail entering the straight and lost touch before two out - well held at the finish
Pulling hard early - tracked the pacesetter - moved through to top spot and driven before 2 out - stayed on to the last then edged away in the closing stages to win
Held up early - pressed leader from 2 out and close up turning for home - lost the front pair's pace in the closing stages to finish second
Went straight to front - unhurried over the opening obstacle - drifted off line nearing the 5th - pressed and lost command before two out then dropped away
Settled just behind the pace - pressed for effort with 3f left - moved through to hit the front inside the final furlong - drew clear to score with ease
Held up in the pack pulling hard early - pressed into effort approaching 2f out - stayed on briefly a furlong out - then passed by the winner and unable to find more
Made the running - pressure applied from 2f out - passed over 1f out - stayed on inside the final furlong before flattening out
Sluggish start - settled in the pack - pushed along with 3f left and kept going without threatening late on
Sat close to pace early - pushed along over 2f out and closed on front-runner - couldn't find more inside final furlong and dropped away - finished fifth
Settled towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - soon dropped away - finished sixth
Held up in rear pulling hard - unable to make impression on leading group - well held at finish
